title: Plans to Tackle Transmission of HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C in Prisons
what_it_is: Plans to Tackle Transmission of HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C in Prisons

sections.label: HIV and Hepatitis in prisons
sections.summary: Asked about plans to tackle HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C transmission in prisons and whether all inmates can be vaccinated for Hepatitis B; no known inmate infections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what plans does the Ministry have to tackle the transmission of HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C in our prisons; and (b) whether the Ministry can ensure that all inmates are vaccinated for Hepatitis B.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There are no known instances of inmates contracting HIV, Hepatitis B or Hepatitis C while they are in prisons.

sections.label: Hepatitis B vaccination not mandatory
sections.summary: Under the NAIS, vaccination for Hepatitis B is not mandatory.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Under the NAIS, vaccination for Hepatitis B is not mandatory.

sections.label: Prisons COVID-19 free
sections.summary: Our prisons have remained COVID-19 free thus far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Our prisons have remained COVID-19 free thus far.

sections.label: New inmate admission monitoring
sections.summary: Newly admitted inmates are housed separately and monitored 14 days with twice-daily temperatures; since 23 March 2020 some are tested for COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: All newly admitted inmates are housed separately from the general population and monitored for 14 days with their temperatures taken twice daily.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Since 23 March 2020, inmates who fulfil the MOH case definitions or have chest x-ray findings suggestive of respiratory infection would be tested for COVID-19.

sections.label: Suspension of prison programmes and visits
sections.summary: From 7 April to 4 May 2020 Prisons suspend external-partner programmes and family visits, allowing local phone calls instead; essential workshops continue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: From 7 April 2020 to 4 May 2020, Prisons will suspend all programmes involving external partners such as work programmes and family programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Workshops considered essential services under MTI's guidelines will also continue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: And from 7 April 2020 to 4 May 2020, Prisons will suspend family visits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: In lieu of visits, Prisons will allow inmates to make local phone calls to keep in touch with their families.
